items.title: Cascadu interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: I know, this is all Chembo does you know.

ctx.x: I didn’t even introduce you on film. This is Cascadú. And I can’t imagine that you ever play a gig where you are coasting. And by that I mean those of us who play gigs all the time, sometimes you’re playing and you know it’s just, you’re looking at your watch and oh man it’s only 8:15 and — when I was watching the three of you yesterday it’s hard for me to imagine that you would do that.
It doesn’t even exist in our timeframe. There’s no timeframe for us. And we could have just gone on and gone on and gone on and gone on you know. But it doesn’t, because I © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

mean you live it. For me, and I know, this is all Chembo does you know. I’ve done a number of other things in my life, but to be doing this now as pretty much the only thing that I do, I consider myself to be very, very fortunate to have some physical health at this stage of my life, and to have the freedom to be able to live my passion now, I mean, for whatever time I have left this is it, and there’s no time on the clock you know. There’s no limitation to what can happen next.
